title: Decide whether to trial a weekly internal research digest

triage.allowed_action: prepare a small internal pilot and collect voluntary feedback
triage.minimum_evidence: three pilot readers and a before-and-after time comparison

hypothesis.best_current_hypothesis: A short, curated digest may reduce repeated research effort without creating an unread reporting burden.
supporting_facts: Several team members ask the same research questions during the week.
No shared summary is currently available.
alternatives: The repeated questions may need a searchable reference rather than a digest.
The main delay may be decision ownership, not missing research.
hypothesis.falsification_signal: Pilot readers do not report a useful decision or time saving after two issues.

contract.goal: Help the team reuse relevant research while the team lead retains the decision to continue.
contract.outcome: A two-issue pilot shows whether readers can use one summary to avoid repeated work.
contract.context: The pilot uses public sources, voluntary readers, and a fixed thirty-minute preparation limit; usefulness is unknown.
contract.risks_review: Pause after two issues if preparation exceeds the limit or feedback shows no use; the team lead reviews the pilot before any expansion.
contract.output: Two internal digest drafts and a one-page pilot summary.
contract.evidence: Reader feedback, preparation time, and one concrete example of reused research.

options.current_route: Run a two-issue internal digest pilot.
options.alternative_route: Create a small searchable reference for recurring questions.
options.third_route: Assign a decision owner for repeated questions before adding a content process.
options.defer_or_shrink: Collect one week of repeated-question examples before producing any digest.

reversible_bet.next_step: Draft one issue from public sources for three voluntary readers.
reversible_bet.expected_signal: At least one reader uses an item in a current decision or task.
reversible_bet.pause_signal: No reader can name a use, or preparation exceeds thirty minutes.
reversible_bet.checkpoint: Review after the second weekly issue.
reversible_bet.continue_evidence: Two readers report a concrete reuse or a measurable reduction in duplicated research.
reversible_bet.rollback: Stop the pilot and retain only the non-sensitive summary notes.
